title: Tattooed Potatoes
description: Halved baking potatoes roasted cut-side down over fresh herbs so the herbs imprint and flavor the browned surface.
ingredients: About 900 g baking potatoes (approximately 4 medium potatoes)
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
Fresh herb sprigs such as sage, rosemary, or thyme, as needed
steps: Wash the potatoes and slice each one lengthwise.
Dip the cut face of each potato in olive oil, then season with salt and pepper.
Place a sprig of fresh herb against each cut face.
Bake at 400°F (204°C) for 40 minutes to 1 hour. Partway through, use a spatula to make sure the potatoes are not sticking.
notes: Paprika source recipe. The original gives 4 baking potatoes but no potato weight, so 900 g is an approximate total based on medium baking potatoes. The original does not specify quantities for oil, salt, pepper, or herbs.
